population.site_histories: twelve constant and twenty-four varying histories, with fresh nuisance labels per frame and one site assignment through the guard
population.null_order: fixed first block at the anchor, uniform permutation of the thirty remaining histories
population.plant_order: fixed first block at the anchor, uniform start for the ordered second block contiguous and separated from the anchor by at least one nuisance site, uniform order of remaining histories

limits: one prespecified anchor and two matched populations at one observation budget; simultaneous one-sided bounds; unresolved nulls count as possible rejections and unresolved plants as misses
